messages:
leah_marketing: Quick sync: Riverside Dev Mixer is Tue evening. Need final decisions: swag mix, stage logistic, and the benchmark banner copy. Also prepping two social posts + post-event nurture. Who can take which?

ben_ops: I can own shipping and stage logistics. Crates need to ship Mon 6pm for Tue 9am setup. I'll book a small van. Any fragile items?

carmen_sales: For lead capture, we want triage tags: product-interest, procurement, partner. Route product-interest -> @carmen_sales, procurement -> sales-ops, partner -> @mike_partner. CRM webhook required.

ops_bot: Shipping reminder queued: Pickup Mon 18:00. ETA Tue 09:00. JOB: SHP-4721.

leah_marketing: Swag proposal: 300 sticker sheets, 180 tees (unisex), 30 hoodies, 150 notebooks. Thoughts? Budget cap $2,200.

tori_eng: Can we reduce hoodies to 20? Those blow the budget. Maybe increase notebooks to 200 — better lead magnet.

mike_partner: Agree on more notebooks. Also we should order 50 sponsor pens with logo for the demo table.

leah_marketing: Updated numbers: stickers 300, tees 180, hoodies 20, notebooks 200, pens 50. I'll send PO after sign-off.

carmen_sales: Lead form fields: email, company, interest (dropdown), company_size (dropdown). Hidden field: event=riverside_mixer_2026. Add UTM to QR.

leah_marketing: Routing config (draft):

route_map:
  product-interest: team-product
  procurement: sales-ops
  partner: biz-dev
utm_source: riverside_mixer_2026
hidden_field: event=riverside_mixer_2026

ops_bot: Reminder: venue requires insurance copy by Mon 12:00. Upload to venue portal.

design: I can make the 24x36 banner. Suggested headline: 'Redwood Inference — Production LLMs at scale'. For the benchmark line, prefer conservative phrasing: 'Typical chat workloads: up to 3x cost reduction vs baseline' 00dpi for print. Need final approval for typography.

leah_marketing: Good. Keep 'up to' per legal. Also need two social drafts: LinkedIn long and X short. Drafts below:
LinkedIn: "Join Redwood Inference at Riverside Dev Mixer — see a live demo of our low-latency serving runtime and get a free notebook. Stop by Booth B2 to chat about predictable inference costs."
X: "Live demo tonight at Riverside Mixer — Booth B2. Chat inference ops. #llm #inference"

mike_partner: On LinkedIn copy, remove 'free' as standard practice. Suggest: 'pick up a notebook' instead.

leah_marketing: Revised LinkedIn: "Join Redwood Inference at Riverside Dev Mixer — stop by Booth B2 for a live demo of our low-latency serving runtime and pick up a notebook."

lina: Will run the demo. FYI I need HDMI, dongles, and offline demo image. Venue wifi is hit-or-miss.

ben_ops: We'll include HDMI and a USB-C adapter in the kit. Ben to bring backup battery pack and power strip.

carmen_sales: Lightning talk update: got a 10-minute slot at 7:40pm. Who's presenting? @mike_partner volunteered earlier.

mike_partner: I can present. Will prepare 4 slides: problem, approach, benchmark, CTA. Need the benchmark figure and a single graph.

tori_eng: I'll prepare a stripped-down benchmark slide with a clear note: dataset and baseline details on the backsheet. Use 'up to' language and link to full benchmark doc.

leah_marketing: Good. Action items: design to finalize banner by Mon 10am, PO for swag after this thread sign-off, Ben to book van and insurance upload, Lina to package offline demo, Carmen to provision CRM webhook and routing, Tori to prepare benchmark slide. I'll schedule posts: LinkedIn at Tue 11:30, X at Tue 16:00, and an event reminder for registrants 1 hour before.

ops_bot: Shipment booked: SHP-4721 pickup Mon 18:00. Insurance upload pending.

lina: Quick QA: lead form length? Keep 4 fields only. People drop off if too long.

carmen_sales: Agreed. Keep minimum. Post-event nurture sequence: Day0: thanks + deck + recording; Day2: notebook PDF + benchmark summary; Day7: case study + meeting CTA.

leah_marketing: I'll draft nurture copy and share for review by Tue noon. Any major blockers?

design: One more: what logo color for banner? Use white-on-midnight-blue for readability.

ben_ops: No blockers here. Van booked.

mike_partner: I'm good. Will practice slides Tue morning.

leah_marketing: Great. I'll publish the runbook and final checklists tomorrow 9am. Thanks team!
